description: The plot compares the performance of two models, 'SMoE Validating' and 'SimSMoE Validating,' in terms of Bits Per Character (BPC) as they undergo training steps. The x-axis, labeled 'Training Steps,' is on a linear scale ranging from 0 to 50, with tick labels at intervals of 10 steps, denoted as 10^3 increments. The y-axis, labeled 'BPC,' is also on a linear scale, ranging from 1.2 to 2.2, with tick labels at intervals of 0.2. The 'SMoE Validating' model is represented by a black line with a cross marker and a solid line style, starting at a BPC value of approximately 1.7 at 0 training steps and showing a sharp decline to 1.25 at step 10, then leveling off to around 1.1 by 50,000 training steps. The 'SimSMoE Validating' model is depicted by a magenta line with a circle marker and a solid line style, beginning at around 2.2 BPC at 0 training steps, also declining sharply to 1.25 at step 10, and stabilizing at approximately 1.15 BPC by 50,000 steps, slightly above the black line. Both lines show a steep initial decline and then become relatively stable as they progress along the x-axis. The SimSMoE model consistently outperforms the SMoE model across all training steps, as indicated by its lower BPC values throughout the plot.
